author: Ruben Hassid
basis: Proposed workflow with brief first-person endorsement
reported_outcomes: Author says the generated draft sounded like him; screenshots and linked demonstrations were not independently evaluated.
proposed_outcomes: Find competing arguments in existing material and keep the choice with the writer.
limits: Three generated options can all share the same framing.
Choosing an argument does not establish that generated prose is personally authored.
Product, pricing and security claims elsewhere are not adopted; selecting a paid plan does not itself settle data permissions.
review_note: Extract only the archive-to-argument procedure from the full available guide, with an explicit human choice before drafting.
coverage: Close-read all 833 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
